desc:
🦖 Welcome to Build Base to Survive DINO!

🧱 Build your own base and prepare for the attack
🔫 Place powerful weapons and defenses to protect yourself
👥 Team up with friends and build an even stronger base
💾 Your builds save automatically
⚒️ Upgrade your base and survive for as long as possible

🌙 WHEN NIGHT FALLS, THE DINOS COME OUT...

🔥 Can your base survive the dinosaur attack?

👍 Like the game for more updates!
